title: Who played drums, trumpet and trombone in the Jazz Babies; where they played
summary: Confused photo identification: drummers Harry Burke and George Trehan, Henry and Merritt Brunies, Abbie not in the band; venues like the Silver Slipper and Nut Club.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
